reasons.plausibility: It follows accepted principles of diffusion vs. kinetic trapping and applies them realistically to high-entropy noble-metal nanoparticles.
reasons.testability: A straightforward experimental comparison of rapid-quench vs. slower-cool protocols with clear measurable outcomes (phase separation vs. single-phase) provides a direct falsification criterion.
reasons.usefulness: It addresses a critical question about controlling structure in noble metal high-entropy nanoparticles, offering a clear strategy and relevant diagnostic tools.
